$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file against

alias.description: Import prefix for the copies; inferred from tsconfig `paths` when omitted

tests.description: Copy a component's tests beside it

routes.description: Route contract `sdxc make controller` adds to, a module in routes/

migrations.description: Migration chains by name; `--chain <name>` picks one

tests.description: Write a test beside every generated file except migrations and factories

specs.description: Write a pairing .spec under spec/ for controllers, commands, MCP tools and scaffolds

stubs.description: Stubs here replace the built-in ones; `sdxc make stubs` copies them out

checks.description: Folder of the project's own checks, each module run by `sdxc doctor`

file.description: Migration file name, without its folder

accept.description: Migration errors `sdxc doctor` steps past, each a file that already ran and the column its error names

max.description: Maximum cyclomatic complexity per function; the complexity check warns above it

moduleLines.description: Maximum code lines per module; the module-size check warns above it

crap.description: Maximum CRAP score per function; the crap check warns above it

coverage.description: Istanbul coverage-final.json the crap check reads, relative to the project root

entry.description: Module `sdxc run` starts, relative to the project root; apps keep the default

format.description: Command run on every file the CLI writes or edits, paths appended

lock.description: Where the CLI keeps its state; commit it with the project
